scripts.test: cucumber-js tests/features/**/*.feature --require-module ts-node/register --require tests/step-definitions/**/*.ts --require tests/support/**/*.ts --format progress
scripts.test:debug: cucumber-js tests/features/**/*.feature --require-module ts-node/register --require tests/step-definitions/**/*.ts --require tests/support/**/*.ts --format progress
scripts.report:json: cucumber-js tests/features/**/*.feature --require-module ts-node/register --require tests/step-definitions/**/*.ts --require tests/support/**/*.ts --format json:reports/cucumber.json
scripts.test:report: npm run report:json && npm run report:html-from-json
